_about: GUARDRAIL-DEMO (not for normal use). Overlay on config/experiments.json, selected with RP_CONFIG_PROFILE=guardrail-demo-error-rate. Removes the declared expected HTTP 500 from dependency_failure, so the first 500 while InfluxDB is down counts as an error and the zero-tolerance error-rate guard must abort and roll back. Targets, mechanism and durations are unchanged. Poll timeout lowered to 2 s (latency cap 1.9 s, must stay below it) so several polls fit in the window: in run 20261010T234226Z-e3e15c the single 8 s poll got no answer at all, so there was no response to judge.

dependency_failure.description: GUARDRAIL-DEMO error rate: stop influxDB with no expected status declared; the first HTTP 500 must trip the error-rate guard.
expected_symptoms: GUARDRAIL-DEMO: the first non-200 response trips guardrail_error_rate (max_error_rate 0.0) and the run rolls back
